status: abstract admissibility scenarios, not browser tests or engine findings

scenarios.input: Class A; page break; one avoid-column, others auto; no ancestor avoid; a legal fitting alternative exists
scenarios.distinguishes: A column-only avoidance must not become unconditional page avoidance; permission does not require choosing this break.

scenarios.input: Class A; every applicable control auto; common ancestor avoid; all constraints still satisfiable elsewhere
scenarios.distinguishes: Rule 1 alone would permit; Rule 2 excludes. Forced-break variant belongs to separate forced path.

scenarios.input: Seven lines; orphans=3, widows=2; all ancestors auto; adequate room and alternatives
scenarios.distinguishes: Cut after line 3 or 4 meets both counts; after 2 fails orphans; after 6 fails widows. No unique-cut oracle.

scenarios.input: Geometric witness: strict opportunities insufficient; dropping only Rule 3 provides enough; alternative A avoid remains active
scenarios.distinguishes: Relaxing every rule immediately is too permissive. The feasibility witness must not be an unchecked caller Boolean.

scenarios.input: No sufficiently fitting opportunities after all rule relaxation; cloned end decorations consume remaining extent; removing end alone suffices
scenarios.distinguishes: Start decoration must not be removed unconditionally; pair with case needing both. Ordinary noncloned decoration is a negative control.

scenarios.input: Oversize monolithic content; no possible below-top opportunity; positive fragment capacity
scenarios.distinguishes: Slicing is an admissible option. Repeated empty fragments are forbidden here. No claim slicing is uniquely required.

scenarios.input: Finite content with a valid break below top; emergency guard false
scenarios.distinguishes: Arbitrary graphical slice is not justified by the emergency clause. Reject a model whose emergency guard is always true.

scenarios.input: Zero-sized box at a break, fitting current fragment; then variant immediately after overflowing content
scenarios.distinguishes: Adjacent best-breaks earlier-side requirement and its exception; a zero-sized box does not itself establish geometric progress.
